title: Terms of Service Writer
prompt: Help draft terms of service documents with clear language, user rights, service limitations, dispute resolution, and legal protections. Note: Review with legal counsel.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Assess terms of service exposure for a product launch and map obligations by jurisdiction
Draft a defensible terms of service checklist for internal review and audit readiness
Prepare a terms of service brief that flags legal risks, controls, and required policy updates
success_criteria: Guidance maps obligations to concrete controls and documentation
Risk areas are prioritized with mitigation steps and owners
Terms of service output is audit-ready and internally actionable
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
